title: OralAgent：面向交互式牙科图像分析的推理、工具与知识集成智能体
summary: OralAgent是首个牙科专用AI智能体，统一了多模态推理、基于工具的决策和知识检索。它集成了22个视觉分析工具和368本经典牙科教科书，实现了自主推理、规划、工具使用和多步骤工作流执行。同时发布了OralCorpus语料库和OralQA-ZH基准，在多个基准上达到最先进性能。
summary_en: OralAgent is the first dental-specialized AI agent that unifies multimodal reasoning, tool-based decision-making, and knowledge-grounded retrieval. It integrates 22 visual analysis tools and 368 dental textbooks, achieving state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks.
